messages:
devin: Putting up a maintenance window for night surge mitigation in eu-west2 (rack euw-11). Window: 2026-06-11 23:30 -> 2026-06-12 01:00 UTC. Purpose: NVMe firmware + NIC bump and thermal baseline recalibration. We'll do 3-node cohorts (not single node) because of noisy neighbors; aim to keep throughput steady. ops-oncall please ack.

marco: ack. cohort size 3 ok, but let's not exceed 18% capacity dip. Are dedicated tenants pinned away?

devin: Yep dedicated pools pinned elsewhere. Expect ~18% transient burstable capacity reduction during cohort handoffs. We'll failover overflow to euw-backup-pool if queue depth > 65%.

nia: Canary cohort = euw-11-{05,06,07} first. If green for 25m, continue cohorts in increment of 3. Pause 12m between cohorts to collect perf.

ops-oncall: I'm available. If any node takes >9m to rejoin or p95 jumps >25% baseline we stop. I'll watch GPU evictions, thermal alarms, queue depth.

maint-bot: Maintenance window created: 2026-06-11T23:30:00Z -> 2026-06-12T01:00:00Z (ID: mw-1890123456). Notifications scheduled.

devin: Runbook snippet (copy into runbook):
```
# cohort flow (3 nodes)
kubectl cordon euw-11-05 euw-11-06 euw-11-07
kubectl drain euw-11-05 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=120
apply-nvme-fw --node euw-11-05 --ver 5.2.1 --verify-checksum
apply-nic-fw --node euw-11-05 --ver 2.3.9
reboot-node euw-11-05 --wait 300
health-checks --node euw-11-05 --checks pcie,nvme,net,gpu-drivers
kubectl uncordon euw-11-05
# repeat for euw-11-06 then euw-11-07
# pause 12m, validate metrics, then proceed to next cohort
```

nia: KV warmup after each cohort (prefixes that matter):
```
euw-cache-seed --pool euw-gpu-pool --prefix "/models/curie" --workers 4
euw-cache-seed --pool euw-gpu-pool --prefix "/chat/recent" --workers 2
```

marco: Cost note: if we route to euw-backup-pool for overflow, expected extra spend ~1.6k EUR for the window. Cost-control-bot, please log contingency and notify finance.

cost-control-bot: Contingency logged: mw-1890123456 estimated overflow cost 1600 EUR. Notifying finance channel.

ops-oncall: Metrics to surface in temp dashboard: p50/p95 latency, queue depth, tokens/sec, GPU mem evictions/min, NVMe IO errors, node-rejoin time. I'll add alert if any node rejoin >9m.

devin: Communication plan: status banner T-30m, customer-success ping T-15m, email to top-8 tenants. Console note: "euw-gpu-pool maintenance". I'll post runbook link right before window.

nia: Can we shorten if first two cohorts are clean? Propose compressing to 45m from 90m if green after 40m. ops-oncall?

ops-oncall: Agree to conditional compression: hold 25m after canary cohorts then accelerate if p95 within 15% of baseline and no evictions. Otherwise stick to full window.

devin: After each successful cohort annotate nodes: `kubectl annotate node euw-11-05 redwood/nvme=5.2.1 redwood/nic=2.3.9` and upload logs: `dmesg`, `nvme list`, `nvidia-smi -q` to s3://redwood-ops/maint/euw/1890123456/.

marco: I'll chase final approval from finance for contingency. If approved we enable overflow routing policy at queue-depth 65%.

maint-bot: Reminder scheduled: 30m pre-notify at 2026-06-11T23:00:00Z.

devin: Thanks all. I'll paste the runbook link here shortly and mark maintenance as confirmed once finance replies. :white_check_mark:
